subject: science
notes: Emperor penguins and Adélie penguins both live in Antarctica.
Emperor penguins are the largest of all penguins, standing about 1.1 meters tall.
Emperor penguins breed during the Antarctic winter, laying their eggs in May or June.
Adélie penguins breed during the Antarctic spring and summer, laying their eggs in October or November.
Adélie penguins build their nests out of small stones.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a difference in when the two kinds of penguins breed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Emperor penguins breed in the Antarctic winter, but Adélie penguins breed in the spring and summer.
choices.B: Emperor penguins and Adélie penguins are two kinds of penguins that both live in Antarctica.
choices.C: Emperor penguins, the largest of all penguins, lay their eggs in May or June.
choices.D: Adélie penguins build their nests out of small stones during the Antarctic spring and summer.

explanation.why: The goal asks for a difference in breeding time, so the sentence must name both kinds of penguins and set their breeding seasons against each other. Only one choice gives the season for each species.
explanation.A: Correct. It contrasts the emperor penguins' winter breeding with the Adélie penguins' spring and summer breeding.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This states something the two penguins have in common, not a difference in when they breed.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It gives the emperor penguins' egg-laying months but says nothing about Adélie penguins, so no difference is shown.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It mentions only Adélie penguins and focuses on their nests, so it cannot show a difference between the two species.
